claim: For the de Meijere--Pugliese--Iñiguez--Simon--Kiss pairwise mean-field contact-tracing threshold system, let \(n>2\), \(R_0=\tau(n-2)>1\), \(a>0\), \(\kappa=(n-1)/n\), \(\delta=(n-2)/n\), and \(\widehat\kappa=\kappa\delta\). If the treatment compliance satisfies \(q_{\min}^t<q\le1\), where \(q_{\min}^t=2(R_0-1)/(R_0n-2)\), then every nonnegative mixed pairwise/triplewise critical point connecting the source's pure thresholds is parameterized uniquely by \(t\in[0,1]\) as \[B(t)=(1-t)\frac{R_0-1}{\kappa}+t\frac{R_0-1}{\delta},\qquad z(t)=\frac{1-(1-q)(B(t)+1)/R_0}{a+R_0},\] \[c_p(t)=\frac{(1-t)(R_0-1)}{\kappa z(t)},\qquad c_t(t)=\frac{t(R_0-1)}{\widehat\kappa z(t)^2}.\] The endpoints are exactly the source's pure critical levels \(c_p^*\) and \(c_t^*\). Writing \(r=z(1)/z(0)\) and \(D(t)=1-t+tr\), the normalized mixed threshold obeys \[\frac{c_p(t)}{c_p^*}+\frac{c_t(t)}{c_t^*}=1-\frac{t(1-t)r(1-r)}{D(t)^2}.\] Consequently, for partial compliance \(q_{\min}^t<q<1\), every interior mixture \(0<t<1\) lies strictly below the straight chord joining the two pure thresholds, while for full compliance \(q=1\) the entire mixed threshold is exactly that chord. This is an exact statement about the source's fast-variable closure and epidemic-threshold equations; it does not assert exactness for the underlying stochastic network epidemic or describe final epidemic size away from threshold.
integrity: The four threshold equations were reconstructed from the open-access article and checked symbolically. Endpoint formulas were compared to the article's displayed pure thresholds. Relevant earlier pairwise/fast-variable contact-tracing literature was inspected for implication. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the motivating article's fast-variable mean-field closure and the connected nonnegative critical branch between its pure pairwise and pure triplewise thresholds. It does not assert exactness for the underlying stochastic network, final-size behavior away from threshold, or synergy along arbitrary intervention paths. The strict inequality excludes full compliance and the singular minimum-compliance endpoint.
title: Exact mixed contact-tracing threshold curve and a strict partial-compliance synergy law
